map_rules.surface_rule: 仅湖岛桥地面并集实际可走位置；不支持水面记录/落点，不另找附近平台

unknown_map_policy: not in exact allowlist means unsupported/reject,never infer permission from map-name prefix; all36training rooms and private/challenge maps excluded

point_validation.id: stable per-character unique ID generated on record; not positional array index
point_validation.pose: finite3D feet/yaw; actual collision-valid current location and reachable nav floor,never UI mouse point or snapped nearby location
point_validation.label: trimmed1..20Unicode characters, reject controls/empty; render as plain text,not markup
point_validation.revision: positive integer<=character revision; overwrite/edit advances,never same revision with new pose
point_validation.world: exact world_id, never convert point for another world; foreign-world points occupy capacity but travel inactive until joined original authority
point_validation.duplicates: same exact world/map/pose not silently merged; explicit separate point consumes another slot
point_validation.schema_boundary: schema validates seven fields, public-map allowlist, 0..30 total entries, label length/edge whitespace/control syntax and positive safe revision. Joint owner validation additionally requires distinct point_id across all worlds, revision<=character revision, strict finite numeric tokens and original-world static pose eligibility; unavailable foreign authority defers only dynamic occupancy checks, never skips static checks.

record.requires: alive,out of combat,idle,no challenge; at least1unreserved carried earth_spirit_talisman; current source map allowed and entry qualification valid; current pose navigation/collision valid
record.new: free slot below30required; allocate stable ID and capture actual feet/yaw atomically
record.overwrite: explicit existing point ID and matching point revision,confirmation showing old/new map+world; preserve ID,replace pose/world/label only by this explicit transaction; no active travel reservation of that point
record.policy_check: training action policy before any create/overwrite; cannot preserve prohibited training point by renaming it
record.replay: same request returns original point ID/revision,not extra slot; failed validation changes nothing

travel.reuse: same alive/out-of-combat/idle/no-challenge/cooldown0,180step channel,damage-first cancellation,600step shared portable_return cooldown,real-unit reservation,atomic consume1/receipt and no healing as base
travel.destination: authoritative existing point world/map/feet/yaw,not client supplied coordinates; must match current world; validate exact current map rule and current entry gate before acceptance and completion
travel.entry_gate: resolve named connection minimum_level/minimum_rank/required_quest; AND checks, source/return edge must not replace forward qualification; missing connection rejects
travel.point_lock: reserve point ID/revision alongside real item during channel; edit/delete/overwrite that point rejected until finish/cancel,other point operations remain allowed when their own command preconditions pass
travel.same_map: distance to stored destination<2.5m rejects; otherwise allowed subject base rules
travel.blocked_or_changed: invalid/occupied/water/closed/nav-invalid target or invalid current gate cancels without cost/cooldown; never pick nearest valid point,delete point or send to town
travel.prohibited_old_point: load rejects forbidden map/invalid pose; do not silently delete corrupted point; a valid formerly reachable point blocked by dynamic actor remains stored but travel fails
travel.supreme: no free/infinite command path until exact supreme entitlement owner is designed; never trust UI subscription flag

manage.rename: alive/out of combat/idle/no challenge,valid point/revision and label; explicit character transaction,does not change coordinates
manage.delete: same conditions,confirmation and revision; no refund/no item required; no active travel reservation; may explicitly remove own foreign-world point without visiting it
manage.no_implicit_eviction: full30rejects new record,does not overwrite oldest

persistence.load: validate0..30unique points,all fields,map allowlist/world identities/finite valid static pose/revisions; new-format missing field rejects,no empty default repair
persistence.inactive_world: validate static config for foreign point; dynamic collision rechecked only when authoritative original world is available; not invalid just because current world differs
persistence.reservations: save point ID/revision and single carried-unit reference in accepted travel action,not second copies of item or pose; restore same action remaining steps via base owner
persistence.host: 05/19same current-revision character transaction,host validates real world and destination; client cannot record arbitrary coordinates or assert entitlement
